name: Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare - Digital Pro Edition
storyline: Set in a near-future world spanning 2054 to 2061, Advanced Warfare follows Jack Mitchell, a young United States Marine whose life is upended in the opening days of a war. During a mission to repel a North Korean invasion of Seoul, Mitchell loses his arm and his close friend Will Irons is killed in action, leaving him medically discharged and adrift. At Will's funeral, Mitchell is approached by Will's father, Jonathan Irons, the charismatic founder and CEO of Atlas, the world's most powerful private military corporation. Irons offers Mitchell a fresh purpose, a cutting-edge prosthetic arm, and a place among Atlas's elite soldiers. As a terrorist group called the KVA unleashes catastrophic attacks around the globe, Atlas steps in where nations falter, rising to become the dominant military power on Earth. Drawn deep into Irons's private army, Mitchell soon finds himself questioning where true loyalty and justice lie.
summary:
Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare envisions the powerful battlegrounds of the future, where both technology and tactic have evolved to usher in a new era of combat. Delivering a stunning performance, Academy Award winning actor Kevin Spacey stars as Jonathan Irons - one of the most powerful men in the world - shaping this chilling vision of the future of war.

The Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare Digital Pro Edition includes two custom weapons and the Advanced Arsenal custom exoskeleton and EM1 Quantum directed energy weapon. Also included are the Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare Season Pass, the Atlas Gorge Bonus MP Map, the Atlas Digital Content Pack, and the Digital Edition Personalization Pack.
